summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Northern Dynasty Minerals Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual general meeting held on June 24, 2026. The meeting considered routine matters: election of directors, appointment of Deloitte as auditor, and approval of share option plan. While one director, Desmond Balakrishnan, received only 53.74% votes for, the filing does not indicate a forced/abrupt departure or any special-situation event. It is a routine meeting notice/proxy circular with no merger, acquisition, tender offer, or activist campaign. No deal terms are stated.
